interpretation: All 18 worlds valid and eligible. Frozen retrieval meets the finite gain floor against fresh baseline and disabled control in all three groups, but beats shuffled proposals in only two. Episode feedback changes decisions but meets its benefit floor in no group; learned influence is unmatched. This is a finite development result, with no held-out, noninferiority, superiority, recoverability or promotion authority.
